metrics.name: absolute_error_near_zero
metrics.justification: Relative error is undefined in practice when |ref| is denormal-scale relative to the bulk of the vector. That pathology produced the 3.23e-3 V2 false reject.

metrics.name: relative_l2_full_vector
metrics.justification: Immune to a single tiny element dominating a max-relative scan; measures overall agreement of the complete logit vector.

metrics.name: meaningful_scale_max_relative
metrics.justification: Same 1e-5 intent as V2, applied only where |ref| ≥ abs_cutoff so the number is a measurement.

metrics.name: ulp_distribution_median_p95_p99_max
metrics.justification: Reported as a distribution, never as a lone max. A large tail on a pass is information about reduction order, not a silent reject.

metrics.name: cosine_similarity
metrics.justification: Direction of the logit vector; catches global scale/shape drift that relative L2 also sees from another angle.

metrics.name: kl_softmax
metrics.justification: Logits are a pre-softmax distribution; KL measures decision-relevant mass, not just Euclidean distance.

metrics.name: exact_topk_and_greedy_argmax
metrics.justification: Discrete decisions are the real contract. Continuous arithmetic may drift within bounds; a different token or top-k set is a different model.

metrics.name: diagnostic_max_scalar_rel_all
metrics.justification: Retains the V2 scalar so a re-run can show why V2 misfired; never used to reject under V2.1.

absolute_error_cutoff_rule: max(1e-30, 1e-6 * median(|reference| over finite elements)); stated on every BackendScore

fp64_authority.rule: Widen little-endian bf16 → f64 via f32 bit-widen then promote; left-to-right f64 Σ per row. Host f32 and device f32 are both candidates, never the oracle.

fixtures.activation_regime: Post-RMSNorm-like O(1) activations (ramp, mod17, ones, zeros, block3, sin, half, mod31, gaussish). Not a 50-order synthetic span.
fixtures.weight_regime: Unit-scale bf16 exponents (exp in [120,134]); replaces the prior bits%0x7F00 generator that freely produced the ill-conditioned span.

sealed_reference_for_scale.note: Tiny GLM fixture logits confirm O(1) is the realistic regime. Full-vocab sealed flagship activations are not loaded in the unit suite (no artifact residency in the sandbox); shapes are reduced (64×32, 257×17, 16×64) for kernel correctness.

commands.sync_derivation_after_ledger: From the ledger JSON: syncs_per_token = aggregate.counters_mean.synchronization_points; wall_ms = aggregate.wall_us.mean / 1000; ms_per_sync = wall_ms / syncs_per_token. Do NOT use 6446 ms or any figure derived from it.

static_reasoning_about_lm_head.label: AWAITING_DEVICE_RUN — not a measured verdict
expectation: With unit-scale weights and O(1) activations, the denormal-scale relative blow-up that sank V2 should not dominate.
Host f32 left-to-right accumulate and device sequential-row gemv_native_bf16_seq should both sit within ~1e-5 relative L2 of the f64 authority for small K, and within reduction-order ULP tails.
Greedy argmax and exact top-5 must match the f64 reference exactly; any mismatch is a real reject.
If the device only fails the V2 diagnostic_max_scalar_rel_all while passing relative_l2 + meaningful_rel + discrete, that confirms the reclassification.
